title: tpu-forward-bench Request
description: Input payload for the tpu-forward-bench agent: measure arms of one served job's forward-pass microbenchmark on the pinned image, each arm an optional vllm_torchtpu change (a campaign-repo ref or registry patches) and a set of plan overrides, and score them with the step-mix cost model against the one baseline arm. The agent writes this request back as forward_bench_request.json with `plan` resolved to its path and `hardware` filled, so a later stage can rerun the identical test by sending that file.

run_id.description: The caller's run; slots are claimed from it.

label.description: Names this request in slot holders and its output directory, e.g. `base`, `2-moe-gate`, `combine`. Unique per run and source job.

engine.description: The inference engine the source job served with, whose engine the twin runs. Values are added as engines gain support (e.g. sglang).

source_job.description: The finished serving job the plan is derived from.

model_dir.description: The model directory under scripts/workload-microbenchmark, e.g. GLM-5.2-FP8. Any other model is `blocked`.

accelerator_type.description: Generation and chip count, e.g. tpu7x-8.

hardware.description: Slot hardware key every job claims. Absent: the first claim takes the most available key, and the result returns it.

image.description: The pinned image, by digest. Every arm runs it; nothing is built.

arms.description: The arms, run on the same plan. Exactly one has `baseline: true`; the others are scored against it.

oneOf.description: Both: matches here too, so it is rejected.

plugin.description: The hill-climb's vllm_torchtpu change as a ref in its campaign repo, `base_sha` this image's plugin commit. Absent for the image as it ships, or with `patches`.

base_sha.description: `base`: the image's own vllm_torchtpu commit. Copied from tpu-code-stack's result, never typed: a short sha padded with zeros is refused.

ref.description: The branch or tag measured, e.g. `stack`, `hyp/2-moe-gate`.

sha.description: The commit `ref` named when it was measured. Copied from tpu-code-stack's result, never typed: a short sha padded with zeros is refused.

patch.description: `git diff base..sha` as plugin_source.py diff wrote it: the one patch the job applies, kept so the arm replays without the repo.

patches.description: vllm_patches registry files (.patch or .py), in apply order, for a caller with no campaign repo, e.g. tpu-model-onboarding's `ready_to_bench` hand-back. Never with `plugin`.

overrides.description: Plan overrides as `points --override` takes them, e.g. `env.NAME=value`; empty for none.

plan.description: The plan this arm ran, when its overrides gave it its own. Filled in the replay record; a caller leaves it out.

oneOf.description: An existing plan: a .steps.json, or the directory of a full-coverage plan.
Build the plan from the source job. Default: top_k 5, scaled.

top_k.description: The K heaviest cells in one plan.

full.description: One plan per cell, the whole step mix; overrides top_k.

repeats.description: Jobs (boots) per arm, launched together; two give the boot-noise floor.

noise_floor_pct.description: Boot-to-boot noise from an earlier A/A of the baseline (its result's noise_spread_pct), used when an arm has one boot.

profile.description: Profile each job and export its rank-0 trace through tpu-diagnostics.

kernel_trace.description: An unscored capture of the inside of Pallas/Mosaic kernels (forward-cmd --kernel-trace: LLO debug info and custom-call tracing; hardware counters on tpu7x). Never an A/B: the flags change the compile key and instrument every kernel.
